title: Assertion catalogue
description: spec/assertions.yaml. Shape only: the level rule, quote and anchor checks are in harness/catalogue.ts.

revision.description: Key into spec/revisions.json that quotes and anchors are checked against.

section.description: Heading anchor in the pinned proposal, e.g. #incremental-sync. Omitted only for lexicon rows and info rows.

quote.description: The sentence under test, copied from the pinned revision. Markdown emphasis, code spans and links may be kept or dropped.

basis.description: Why the level is what it is. Required for must and should.

requires.description: Capability paths the implementation must claim, resolved against its manifest's capabilities, e.g. policies.managedspace, oauth.scripted.

lexicon.description: Lexicon NSID, when basis includes lexicon.

checks.description: What the test does, in one or two sentences.

since.description: First revision the assertion is valid for.

until.description: Last revision the assertion is valid for.

provisional.description: Set until two implementations with different lineage pass it (design ch. 3.4).
